en: Earth's seasons are caused by its 23.5-degree axial tilt, not by being closer to the Sun during summer.
The Moon does not produce its own light, but instead shines by reflecting sunlight off its rocky surface.
Clouds are not made of invisible water vapor, but rather consist of millions of tiny liquid water droplets or ice crystals.
The Sun is not a giant ball of burning fire, but a star powered by nuclear fusion in its core.
Diamonds do not form from compressed coal, but crystallize from pure carbon deep within the Earth's mantle under extreme heat.
The Moon actually rotates on its axis, completing one spin in the exact same time it takes to orbit Earth.
Earthquakes do not happen when tectonic plates slide smoothly, but occur when stuck plates suddenly release built-up stress and snap.
Soil is not just crushed rock, but a complex mixture of weathered minerals, decaying organic matter, water, and trapped air.
Meteorites are not glowing hot when they land, but are usually cold to the touch because outer space is freezing.
Tectonic plates do not float on liquid magma, but move over the solid yet plastically flowing rock layer called the asthenosphere.
Lightning frequently strikes the same tall structures multiple times, with the Empire State Building hit dozens of times every year.
The water cycle is not just evaporation and rain, but includes transpiration, where plants release water vapor from their leaves.
